scripts.codegen:check: npm run codegen:api || { echo 'codegen failed: could not read the OpenAPI document. Inside the frontend container ../backend does not exist — copy it in first: docker compose cp backend/openapi.json frontend:/tmp/openapi.json && OPENAPI_SCHEMA=/tmp/openapi.json npm run codegen:check'; exit 1; }; git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'types regenerated. Skipping the committed/stale checks: no git repo is visible from here, which is expected inside the container. CI runs them.'; exit 0; }; git ls-files --error-unmatch types/api.d.ts > /dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'types/api.d.ts is not committed — commit it'; exit 1; }; git diff --exit-code -- types/api.d.ts || { echo 'types/api.d.ts is stale — the API changed. Commit the regenerated file.'; exit 1; }
